mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' AND U.USER_ID <> #{departmentApproverId} ORDER BY U.USER_NAME, U.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL ( APPROVAL_ID, REQUEST_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, APPROVAL_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_APPROVAL.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalOrder}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
